Description
This container includes the MII interface configuration between an Ethernet Controller
and the Ethernet Transceiver. If this container is configured the EthTrcv shall call Eth_
WriteMii / Eth_ReadMii API to access the hardware ethernet tranceiver. Note: In case
of external MACPHY use this parameter may be enabled.
